records.title: TerViT: An Efficient Ternary Vision Transformer
records.reason: TerViT uses ternary weights/activations in vision transformer models and studies accuracy/efficiency tradeoffs. This has a direct low-bit transformer mechanism but is vision-specific, so its connection to the linked BERT quantization lineage needs follow-up.

records.title: Tailoring Instructions to Student’s Learning Levels Boosts Knowledge Distillation
records.reason: The work tailors instructions to student difficulty for knowledge distillation and reports learning gains. Its contribution is distillation data/training, not model inference compression or serving efficiency; the connection to TernaryBERT is weak.

records.title: Dynamic Stashing Quantization for Efficient Transformer Training
records.reason: Dynamic Stashing Quantization targets transformer/LLM training: it dynamically quantizes stashed activations between forward/backward passes to reduce arithmetic and DRAM operations. Full text reports up to 20.95x fewer arithmetic operations and 2.55x fewer DRAM operations on IWSLT17, but it optimizes training rather than inference.

records.title: Uncertainty-Aware Image Captioning
records.reason: The paper proposes uncertainty-aware image captioning methods and evaluates caption quality/uncertainty. It does not study inference resource efficiency; the relation to iterative-refinement captioning is task-level only.

records.title: Reconfigurable Stream Network Architecture
records.reason: The paper presents a reconfigurable stream-network architecture and evaluates streaming dataflow hardware. It does not establish a transformer/LLM inference workload or model-specific speed/memory result; retain only as a weak hardware-architecture connection to accelerator lineage.
